name: bencode
description: BitTorrent bencode format encoder and decoder supporting strings, integers, lists, and dictionaries as used in .torrent files.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when working with BitTorrent .torrent files, DHT (distributed hash table) protocols, or any system that uses the bencode serialization format. encode() converts JS values to bencode byte strings; decode() parses bencode back to JS values.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: The JavaScript value to encode to bencode format.

parameters.name: buffer
parameters.description: The bencode string or byte buffer to decode into a JavaScript value.
